reader0_OSError.note: healed_at_any_reopen=True means an INTERNAL plateau of >= one reopen interval (300s, zero delta in the summed 4-query reader_errors_total counter) was observed, followed by renewed growth later in the run -- i.e. the error class actually stopped firing for a while and later recurred. Cross-checked against queries_total for the same reader over one such window (reader 0, OSError, 1789873699-1789909082, 35382.5s): queries_total climbs steadily and slowly throughout (298->406, i.e. real completed query cycles), while reader_errors_total is exactly flat -- this is genuine intermittent recovery, not a metrics-reporting gap (the sampling cadence stays ~60-70s throughout, matching rss_kb's own regular cadence for the same reader). active_run_count = n_healing_intervals + 1 is therefore the reader's TRUE number of distinct error episodes for this class, which is larger than the ledger's onset count (D-088 only logs the FIRST-ever occurrence of a given (reader,class) signature, not each time it recurs after healing). tail_flat_span_s is the flat run (if any) that extends to the reader's last sample -- not itself evidence of healing, since the run simply ends there.

method: ledger_events_verbatim is every longevity_ledger.jsonl line with event=reader_op_error, copied verbatim (this is the D-088 bounded reader-error-message capture). per_reader_totals_by_class sums each reader's error_details[].count from reader-<idx>-progress.json (final cumulative counts), grouped by exception class -- these match the manifest's reader_errors_total (2,203,551,806) when summed across all readers/classes. per_reader_episode_count is the number of distinct (class, message/file-pattern) onset entries in that reader's error_details, which is a 1:1 match with that reader's ledger reader_op_error lines (each ledger line is emitted once, at first occurrence of a new (reader,class) combination with count_at_first_seen=1). healed_at_next_reopen_evidence checks metrics.jsonl's reader_errors_total counter series per (reader,class) for any plateau of >= one reader-reopen interval (300s) after onset followed by renewed growth; none found means the condition never cleared at any of that reader's 777-779 reopens before RUN_DONE.
